# Apache Casbin

> Apache Casbin (Incubating) is an open-source authorization library that supports access control models like ACL, RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC, PBAC, BLP, Biba and more. A model file (PERM: policy, effect, request, matchers) and policy rules decide every request, and the same model works in Go, Java, Node.js, Python, .NET, PHP, Rust, C++ and other languages.

## Basics

- [Aperçu](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/overview/): Apache Casbin is an open-source authorization library for Go, Java, Node.js, Python, .NET, PHP, Rust and C++ that supports ACL, RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC and more.
- [Commencer](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/get-started/): Install Casbin for Go, Java, Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, C++ or Rust, create an enforcer from a model and policy, and run your first authorization check.
- [How It Works](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/how-it-works/): How Casbin works - the PERM metamodel (Policy, Effect, Request, Matchers) and CONF model files that let you switch between ACL, RBAC, ABAC and custom models.
- [Tutoriels](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/tutorials/): Casbin papers, videos and community tutorials for Go, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, .NET and other languages, plus articles on modeling with PERM.

## Guides

- [Golang RBAC Tutorial: Role-Based Access Control in Gin](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/go-rbac-tutorial/): Step-by-step Go RBAC tutorial - add role-based access control to a Gin REST API with Casbin, including the model, policy, middleware, and runtime role management.
- [Node.js RBAC Tutorial: Role-Based Access Control in Express](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/nodejs-rbac-tutorial/): Step-by-step Node.js RBAC tutorial - add role-based access control to an Express REST API with Casbin, including the model, policy, middleware, and runtime role management.
- [Python RBAC Tutorial: Role-Based Access Control in FastAPI](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/python-rbac-tutorial/): Step-by-step Python RBAC tutorial - add role-based access control to a FastAPI REST API with PyCasbin, including the model, policy, dependency, and runtime role management.
- [Spring Boot RBAC Tutorial: Role-Based Access Control with jCasbin](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/java-rbac-tutorial/): Step-by-step Java RBAC tutorial - add role-based access control to a Spring Boot REST API with jCasbin, including the model, policy, interceptor, and runtime role management.
- [NestJS RBAC Tutorial: Role-Based Access Control with Guards](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/nestjs-rbac-tutorial/): NestJS RBAC tutorial: role-based access control with role inheritance for a NestJS API, using node-casbin, a global guard and a permission decorator.
- [RBAC in Rust with Axum](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rust-rbac-tutorial/): Rust RBAC tutorial: role-based access control for an Axum REST API with casbin-rs, including the model, policy, middleware and runtime role changes.
- [gRPC Authorization in Go](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/grpc-rbac-tutorial/): Role-based access control for a Go gRPC service with Casbin: unary and stream interceptors that check the caller's role against the full method name.
- [ABAC in Go](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/go-abac-tutorial/): Go ABAC tutorial: attribute-based access control for a net/http API with Casbin, using owner, department and status to decide who can read, edit and publish.
- [ABAC in Node.js with Express](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/nodejs-abac-tutorial/): Node.js ABAC tutorial: attribute-based access control for an Express API with node-casbin, using owner, department and status to decide who can edit.
- [ABAC in Python with Flask](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/flask-abac-tutorial/): Python ABAC tutorial: attribute-based access control for a Flask API with PyCasbin, using owner, department and status to decide who can read and edit.
- [Autorisation pour les agents IA et les outils MCP](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/ai-agent-authorization/): Contrôlez quels outils un agent IA peut appeler avec Casbin : permissions par agent, limites sur les arguments, règles de refus, et pas plus d'accès que son utilisateur. Avec un exemple MCP.

## Access Control Models

- [RBAC vs ABAC vs ACL vs ReBAC : Choisir un modèle de contrôle d'accès](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/access-control-models/): Comparaison de ACL, RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC et PBAC sur un même exemple : ce que chacun décide, ses points forts, ses faiblesses, quand le choisir et comment combiner RBAC avec ABAC.
- [Supported Models](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/supported-models/): Access control models supported by Casbin - ACL, RBAC, RBAC with domains, ABAC, ReBAC, PBAC, BLP, Biba, LBAC, OrBAC, UCON, RESTful, IP match, deny-override and priority.
- [Model Syntax](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/syntax-for-models/): Casbin model syntax reference - request, policy, role and effect definitions and matchers in CONF files, with operators and examples.
- [**Effector**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/effector/): L'interface Effector de Casbin combine les effets de toutes les règles de politique correspondantes en une seule décision, pour les effets allow-override, deny-override, priority et personnalisés.
- [Functions](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/function/): Built-in Casbin matcher functions - keyMatch, keyMatch2-5, regexMatch, ipMatch, globMatch and key extraction - and how to register your own custom functions.
- [RBAC Overview](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-overview/): Overview of role-based access control (RBAC) in Casbin - basic RBAC, resource roles, domains (multi-tenancy), pattern matching and conditional roles.
- [What is RBAC? Role-Based Access Control in Casbin](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac/): What role-based access control (RBAC) is and how to use it in Casbin: define roles with role_definition, assign users to roles, build role hierarchies and check roles in matchers.
- [RBAC with Pattern](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-with-pattern/): Use wildcards and patterns in Casbin role assignments and domains with AddNamedMatchingFunc and AddNamedDomainMatchingFunc.
- [RBAC with Domains](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-with-domains/): Multi-tenant RBAC with Casbin - give the same user different roles in different domains or tenants with a three-argument role definition.
- [RBAC with Conditions](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-with-conditions/): Attach conditions to Casbin role assignments with the conditional role manager, for example roles that are valid only within a time window.
- [**RBAC vs. RBAC96**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-96/): Comment le **RBAC** de Casbin se rapporte à la norme **RBAC96** : utilisateurs et rôles, hiérarchies de rôles, sessions et contraintes, ainsi que ce que Casbin ajoute avec les domaines et les permissions flexibles.
- [What is ReBAC? Relationship-Based Access Control with Examples](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rebac/): What relationship-based access control (ReBAC) is, how it relates to Google Zanzibar, how it differs from RBAC and ABAC, and how to model user-resource relationships in Casbin.
- [Qu'est-ce que l'ABAC ? Contrôle d'accès basé sur les attributs avec exemples](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/abac/): Ce qu'est le contrôle d'accès basé sur les attributs (ABAC), comment il diffère du RBAC, et comment écrire des règles ABAC dans Casbin : comparer les attributs utilisateur, ressource et environnement dans le matcher ou stocker les conditions comme politique.
- [What is PBAC? Policy-Based Access Control in Casbin](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/pbac/): What policy-based access control (PBAC) is, how it differs from ABAC and RBAC, and how to store rule expressions as policy in Casbin and evaluate them at runtime with eval().
- [MAC Overview](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/mac-overview/): Mandatory access control (MAC) in Casbin - label-based models such as Bell-LaPadula, Biba and LBAC that users cannot override.
- [BLP](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/blp/): Implémentez le modèle de confidentialité Bell-LaPadula (BLP) dans Casbin - niveaux de sécurité pour les sujets et les objets, avec les règles no read up et no write down.
- [Modèle d'intégrité Biba : Pas de lecture descendante, pas d'écriture ascendante](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/biba/): Implémentez le modèle d'intégrité Biba dans Casbin - niveaux d'intégrité pour les sujets et les objets, avec les règles de non-lecture descendante et de non-écriture ascendante.
- [What is LBAC? Lattice-Based Access Control in Casbin](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/lbac/): What lattice-based access control (LBAC) is, how it combines confidentiality and integrity levels, and how to enforce both in one Casbin model.
- [OrBAC](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/orbac/): Implement organisation-based access control (OrBAC) in Casbin - roles, activities and views mapped to concrete users, actions and objects per organization.
- [Priority Model](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/priority-model/): Resolve conflicting rules with the Casbin priority model - implicit priority by policy order, explicit priority fields, and role-hierarchy-based priority.
- [What is Usage Control (UCON)? Continuous Authorization](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/ucon/): What usage control (UCON) is: authorizations, obligations and conditions checked continuously during use, with mutable attributes, and how to implement it with Casbin.
- [Super Administrator in Casbin: Bypass Policy Checks](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/superadmin/): What a super administrator (root) is in Casbin, how to add one to the matcher, and how the same pattern works with RBAC, ABAC and RBAC with domains.

## Storage

- [Model Storage](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/model-storage/): Load a Casbin model from a CONF file, from a string or from code. Models define your access control logic and are read-only at runtime.
- [Policy Storage](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/policy-storage/): Store Casbin policy rules in a CSV file, a database or any other backend through adapters, and load or save them through the adapter API.
- [Loading Policy Subsets](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/policy-subset-loading/): Load only a subset of Casbin policy rules with filtered adapters and LoadFilteredPolicy(), to save memory in large or multi-tenant deployments.

## Use Cases

- [**Data Permissions**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/data-permissions/): Autorisations au niveau des données avec Casbin - interrogez les rôles et permissions implicites via la hiérarchie RBAC, et filtrez les jeux de données avec BatchEnforce().
- [Nested Organizations](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/nested-organizations/): Model nested organizations in Casbin - grant a role at a unit and inherit it through the whole subtree with domain paths and a descendant matching function.
- [List Filtering](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/list-filtering/): Filter list and search results with Casbin - BatchEnforce, per-unit implicit permissions, a materialized permission table, and Postgres RLS, plus the query-planner gap.
- [Menu Permissions](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/menu-permissions/): Menu-based access control with jCasbin and Spring Boot - map roles to menus and submenus and show each user only the menu items they may access.

## Plugins

- [Plugin Overview](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/plugins-overview/): Overview of Casbin plugins - adapters, watchers, dispatchers, role managers and middleware that connect Casbin to databases, message buses and web frameworks.
- [Agents](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/enforcers/): L'Enforcer est la structure principale dans Casbin qui sert d'interface permettant aux utilisateurs d'effectuer des opérations sur les règles de politique et les modèles.
- [Adaptateurs](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/adapters/): Les adaptateurs Casbin chargent et sauvegardent les règles de politique dans MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, des fichiers et des dizaines d'autres magasins. Trouvez l'adaptateur pour votre langage et votre base de données.
- [Watchers](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/watchers/): Casbin watchers keep policy in sync across multiple enforcer instances through etcd, Redis, Kafka, NATS and other message buses.
- [**Dispatchers**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/dispatchers/): Les dispatchers Casbin propagent les modifications incrémentales de la politique à chaque enforceur dans un cluster en utilisant un protocole de cohérence tel que Raft, sans modifier l'API Casbin.
- [Role Managers](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/role-managers/): Casbin role managers resolve the RBAC role hierarchy, either from policy in memory or from external sources such as LDAP, Okta, Auth0 and Azure AD.
- [Middleware](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/middlewares/): Casbin authorization middleware for web frameworks and API gateways - Gin, Echo, Express, Koa, NestJS, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Laravel and more.
- [Kong Authorization](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/kong-authz/): kong-authz is a Kong API Gateway plugin that authorizes requests with lua-casbin. Install it, configure a model and policy, and protect your Kong routes.
- [GraphQL Middleware](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/graphql-middlewares/): Add authorization to GraphQL APIs with Casbin - enforce access on types, fields and operations in resolvers, with middleware for popular GraphQL servers.
- [**Cloud Native**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/cloud-native/): Utilisez Casbin pour l'autorisation dans les stacks cloud-native : projets intégrant Casbin avec Envoy, Istio, Traefik, KubeSphere et autres infrastructures.

## API

- [API Overview](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/api-overview/): Aperçu des principales API Casbin - Enforce, BatchEnforce, EnforceEx, l'API de gestion et l'API RBAC - avec des exemples utilisant un modèle RBAC et une politique CSV.
- [Management API](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/management-api/): Casbin Management API reference - get, add, remove, update and filter policy rules and role assignments at runtime, with examples for each language.
- [RBAC API](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-api/): A more friendly API for RBAC. This API is a subset of Management API. The RBAC users could use this API to simplify the code
- [RBAC with Domains API](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-with-domains-api/): A more user-friendly API for RBAC with domains. This API is a subset of the Management API. RBAC users can use this API to simplify their code.
- [RBAC with Conditions API](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rbac-with-conditions-api/): API reference for Casbin RBAC with conditions - register condition functions on user-role links and pass parameters to them.
- [Role Manager API](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/rolemanager-api/): The RoleManager API provides an interface for defining operations to manage roles. The addition of a matching function to the RoleManager allows the use of wildcards in role names and domains.

## Advanced Usage

- [Production Deployment](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/production-deployment/): Run Casbin in production - one enforcer per process, thread safety with SyncedEnforcer, decision caching, keeping replicas in sync with watchers, and writing policy inside database transactions.
- [Multithreading](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/multi-threading/): Use Casbin safely in multi-threaded code with the synchronized enforcer (SyncedEnforcer) in Go, Java, C++ and other languages.
- [**Benchmarks**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/benchmark/): Benchmarks d'application de la politique Casbin - temps et mémoire par appel Enforce() pour les modèles ACL, RBAC, ABAC, RESTful et autres, de quelques règles jusqu'à 110 000 règles de politique.
- [Performance Optimization](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/performance/): Optimize Casbin at scale - handle high request volume with synchronized enforcers and sharding, and reduce memory with filtered policy loading.
- [Kubernetes Admission Webhook](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/k8s-gatekeeper/): Casbin K8s-Gatekeeper is a Kubernetes admission webhook that allows or denies operations on any Kubernetes resource using declarative Casbin models and policies.
- [Envoy (Autorisation Service Mesh)](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/envoy/): Autorisez le trafic service mesh avec Casbin via l'autorisation externe Envoy - envoy-authz applique les politiques RBAC et ABAC pour Envoy et Istio.

## Management

- [**Admin Portal**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/admin-portal/): Gérez les modèles et les politiques Casbin dans une interface web. **Casdoor** et d'autres portails d'administration fournissent des éditeurs de modèles, des éditeurs de politiques et une gestion des permissions par-dessus Casbin.
- [Casbin Service](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/service/): Run Casbin as a remote authorization service over gRPC or HTTP with Casbin Server and other projects, instead of embedding the library.
- [**Command-line Tools**](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/command-line-tools/): Outils en ligne de commande Casbin pour Go, Java, Node.js, Python, .NET et Rust - chargez un modèle et une politique, exécutez des vérifications d'application et gérez la politique depuis votre shell.
- [Logging & Error Handling](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/log-error/): Enable and customize logging in Casbin for requests, model loading and policy changes, and handle errors returned by the enforcer.
- [Intégration Frontend](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/frontend/): Casbin.js est un addon Casbin qui facilite la gestion du contrôle d'accès dans l'application frontend

## Editors & Tools

- [Online Editor](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/online-editor/): Write and test Casbin models and policies in the browser with the online editor - syntax highlighting, completion, AI assistance and instant enforce results.
- [IDE Plugins](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/ide-plugins/): Casbin plugins for JetBrains IDEs and Visual Studio Code - syntax highlighting and editing support for model and policy files.

## Comparisons

- [Casbin vs. Alternatives](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/comparison/): How Apache Casbin compares with OpenFGA, Open Policy Agent (OPA), CASL, and Cedar - library or service, policy language, access control models, language support, and when to choose each.
- [Casbin vs. OpenFGA](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/casbin-vs-openfga/): Comparaison entre Apache Casbin et OpenFGA - bibliothèque intégrée versus service de type Zanzibar, modélisation RBAC et ReBAC, stockage, caractéristiques de performance, et quand choisir chacun.
- [Casbin vs. Open Policy Agent (OPA)](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/casbin-vs-opa/): Comparaison entre Apache Casbin et Open Policy Agent - modèle et données de politique versus Rego, bibliothèque intégrée versus agent de politique, gestion des politiques à l'exécution, prise en charge des langages, et quand choisir chacun.
- [Casbin vs. CASL](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/casbin-vs-casl/): Comparaison entre Apache Casbin et CASL pour les applications JavaScript et TypeScript - règles en tant que données versus capacités dans le code, utilisation frontend et backend, services multi-langages, et quand choisir l'un ou l'autre.
- [Casbin vs. Cedar](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/casbin-vs-cedar/): Comparaison entre Apache Casbin et Cedar - modèle PERM configurable versus le langage de politique Cedar, validation et analyse, support des langages, stockage des politiques, et quand choisir l'un ou l'autre.

## About & More

- [Contributing](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/contributing/): How to contribute to Apache Casbin - core libraries and language ports, adapters, middleware, the website and translations - and how to get started.
- [Politique de confidentialité](https://casbin.apache.org/fr/docs/privacy-policy/): Privacy policy for the Apache Casbin website and sign-in services: what information is collected, how it is used, stored and shared.
